verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents its own noise-reduction controls. Errors can be snoozed or ignored (docs-28), and dashboard discard rules control which events are saved and counted (docs-14), now enforced source-side on mobile SDKs (docs-35). Rate limiting exists only as an option for daily event quota overages (docs-47), which is about billing quota rather than alert throttling, and the PagerDuty integration (docs-9) shows paging but no documented throttling of pages. missing for 10: explicit spike protection, per-key/per-project rate limits, alert-notification throttling or de-duplication rules, hands-on corroboration that these controls prevent overnight paging.
